protocol.decision: Strict abs(S-mu)>z_(1-alpha/2)*sqrt(variance); equality is acceptance. Both rules use the same exact mean and same observed scores.
protocol.naive_variance: sum_e c_e Var(|D_i-D_j|), treating all nonnegative weighted pair occurrences as independent. This is not sum_e c_e^2 Var(h_e).
protocol.uncertainty: Pointwise95%Wilson intervals for each fixed-rule rejection probability; no simultaneous equivalence claim. alpha=.001 uses about20expected rejections forR20000 andabout5 for the256² R5000case, so it is exploratory.
protocol.diagnostics: Empirical mean/variance vs exact, standardized mean, variance ratio, normal quantiles, empirical CDFdistance. Known nonuniform and sparse laws are distinct specified nulls, not robustness under unknown misspecification.

summary.interval_interpretation: Pointwise Wilson intervals for the fixed rule's true rejection probability under the specified null. No simultaneous or equivalence claim.
